blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The Zamboanga City local government suspended classes from pre-school to Grade 12 in both public and private schools Thursday, October 22, as the heat index reached a dangerous 43 degrees Celsius (°C). The class suspension was declared by City Caretaker and Administrator Percival Ramos upon the instruction of Zamboanga City Mayor Khymer Olaso, following the latest forecast from the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa).
